text:
Priority: urgent
Retry of 20261029-233021-e5sg (rejected). The throughput section's landing stage reports a median of 273.8 minutes for landing and rebuild, while real landings take minutes (job 20261029-130605-mbpm: outcome 20:41:09 UTC, its commit on main at 20:44:56 UTC). Match each job to its own landing evidence, and when none is found say so for that job instead of borrowing another record. Depends on 20261030-070002-d103 (the evidence snapshot that makes the real-records check possible).
Lessons from the rejection:
- A job's own outcome or candidate commit time is not landing evidence; only its landing record or the commit on main that carries it counts.
- Match a main commit to a job by the job id in its trailer or in the records it adds, not by a substring of the whole message.
- Change only the files listed below.
Acceptance:
- A test with fixture records covers a job with its own landing record, a job without one, and a neighbouring job's record that must not be used.
- athena status run against the job's evidence snapshot (shown in the job report, repeatable by the verifier) gives, for the five most recent landed jobs, landing durations within 3 minutes of the time between each job's outcome and its commit on main.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-core/src/store.rs, crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs, CHANGELOG.md
